name: 99 Nights in the Forest
creator: Grandma's Favourite Games
redeem: Launch 99 Nights in the Forest on Roblox and stay in the lobby. Codes are redeemed there, not during a run.
Click the Diamonds icon with the plus sign in the bottom left corner of the screen.
Press the Codes button along the bottom of the shop window that opens.
Type or paste a code and press Submit. Your Diamonds show up in the counter right away.
notes:
99 Nights in the Forest is a co-op survival horror game where you and your friends try to last 99 nights in a dark forest while searching for missing kids. During the day you chop wood, gather food and scrap, and upgrade your campfire so its light reaches farther. At night the Deer and other creatures come out, so you need a strong fire, crafted gear and a plan. Leaving a match resets that run, but lobby progress saves.

Codes here mostly give Diamonds, the lobby currency you spend on classes, which change your perks and starting gear. Diamonds are the most useful reward because a good class can make the first nights much easier. Some codes also add Flame items. New codes tend to arrive with big updates and events, and they are announced in the game's Discord.

codes.reward: 15 Diamonds and 3 Flames (Frog, Thanksgiving and Fairy)

faq.q: What should I spend my 99 Nights Diamonds on?
faq.a: Save them for a class. Classes change your perks for every run, so one good class is worth more than spreading Diamonds across small items.

faq.q: Can I redeem 99 Nights codes in the middle of a match?
faq.a: No. The codes menu is in the lobby, so finish or leave your run first, then open the Diamonds shop in the bottom left corner.

faq.q: Why does a 99 Nights code say it does not work?
faq.a: Each code works once per account, so it may already be claimed, or it expired after an update. Copy it exactly with lowercase letters and no extra spaces.

tips: Spend your first day chopping trees and hauling logs back to the campfire. A bigger fire lights up more ground at night, and staying inside that light is the safest place to be.
Bring scrap back to camp along with wood. Scrap goes into the crafting bench, and upgrading the bench unlocks better tools and items for your base.
Watch your hunger bar. Cook raw meat on the campfire before eating it, and keep some food stored at camp so nobody has to go hunting after dark.
Split up the jobs with your team. One player can keep the fire fed while the others gather food and scrap, which saves time and keeps someone at camp.
useRewards: The three working codes add up to 45 Diamonds, which can bring a class you want much closer. Redeem them together from the lobby before your next run so you can see your full total at once. The Flames from awardwinner_yay and forestwakesup26 come on top of the Diamonds, so there is no reason to wait.
